The main takeaway from our work is that
, for out-of-order stream applications that require high result accuracy, the disorder handling approach can be made user-configurable to meet different application requirements.
, for applications that are not latency-critical, the user should have a choice to trade-off the result latency for the query result accuracy.

, for out-of-order data stream processing, it is important for users to be able to specify the extent of trade-offs they prefer between result latency and accuracy, and that the system should be able to meet the specified trade-off in an efficient manner.
